subject: Startups
title: Sustainable Growth Wins
description: A 60-second lesson on Sustainable Growth Wins.

hook.text: Basecamp has been profitable since day one. No VC money, no blitzscaling. Just steady growth for 20+ years.

buildup.text: Mailchimp bootstrapped to $12 billion. Atlassian IPO'd with no sales team. Slow, efficient growth compounds.

discovery.text: Companies that grow sustainably retain more customers, need less funding, and keep more equity for founders.

twist.text: VC-backed startups face pressure to grow 3x annually.

climax.text: After the 2023 tech layoffs, bootstrapped companies kept hiring. The tortoise companies outlasted the hares.

punchline.text: The best growth hack: don't run out of money.

quiz.question: What do Basecamp and Mailchimp have in common?
options: Both raised billions in VC funding
Both bootstrapped to profitability without VC
